content.text:
* Complementary-input, two-stage continuous-time OTA
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* Reference and current distribution
XBN IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XBPDRV BPC IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XBP BP BP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=40 l=1 nf=1 m=1
RBPC BP BPC 20000
* Complementary differential pairs, total nominal tails 20 uA each
XNT SN IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XNP DN VINN SN VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=80 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XNN DN2 VINP SN VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=80 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XNFT1 DN BP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XNFT2 DN2 BP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XNFC1 DNC BPC DN VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=60 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XNFC2 G BPC DN2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=60 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XNDC DNC DNC VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XNSC G DNC VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XPT SP BP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=80 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XPP DP VINN SP VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=2
XPN G VINP SP VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=2
XPL1 DP DP VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XPL2 G DP VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=1 m=1
* Output gain stage, approximately 200 uA
XOUTN VOUT G VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=70 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XOUTP VOUT BP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 nf=1 m=8
* Miller compensation with a zero-control resistor
RC G CC 1000
CC CC VOUT 3p
.ends DUT
